reviewItem.question: For "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: return errors.New(\"Crossplane no longer supports loading and patching EnvironmentConfigs natively. Please use…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core removed the code that returned an error when --enable-environment-configs was set. That error said native EnvironmentConfig loading and patching was no longer supported and the flag would be removed in a future release.
